Adds a projection candidate when possible, deduplicates identical candidates, prefers `ParamEnv` candidates over others, and otherwise converts a conflicting single candidate into ambiguity. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Instantiates a higher-ranked projection obligation in a fresh universe, calls `project_and_unify_term` to solve it, and wraps mismatches while optionally filtering obligations that mention the new universe under `generic_associated_types_extended`.

Normalizes a projection term, replaces opaque types in the expected term with inference variables, and equates the normalized and expected terms to produce obligations or a mismatch. It calls `opt_normalize_projection_term`.

Normalizes an associated type projection into a `Term`, and if normalization is ambiguous or fails, creates a fresh inference-backed projection to defer resolution. It calls `opt_normalize_projection_term`.

Core projection normalizer that consults the projection cache, detects recursion, projects the alias term, recursively normalizes any remaining aliases, and caches progress, ambiguity, or trait-selection failure. It calls `normalize_to_error` and `project`.

Produces an error-tolerant normalized term by creating a fresh type or const inference variable and adding the projected trait obligation so trait solving can continue. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Normalizes an inherent associated type by checking recursion depth, computing impl arguments, adding instantiated predicates as obligations, and normalizing the resulting type if it still contains aliases. It calls `compute_inherent_assoc_ty_args`.

Infers the impl arguments for an inherent associated type by freshening the parent impl args, normalizing the impl self type and projection self type when needed, and equating them before rebasing the alias arguments onto the impl. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Constructs a `Progress` value whose term is an error type and whose obligations list is empty; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Appends additional obligations to an existing `Progress` result and returns it; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Top-level projection solver that checks recursion and prior errors, assembles candidates from the parameter environment, trait definition, object bounds, and impl selection, then either confirms a unique candidate or returns ambiguity/error/no-progress. Collects projection candidates from the caller bounds in the parameter environment. It calls `assemble_candidates_from_predicates`.

Scans item bounds from the trait definition for matching projection clauses, pushes matching trait-definition candidates, and marks ambiguity when matching cannot be decided. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::push_candidate` and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous`.

Builds projection candidates from object type projection bounds when the trait supports object-based projection, and marks ambiguity if the self type is still a type variable. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous` and `assemble_candidates_from_predicates`.

Filters a stream of projection predicates by associated item and argument compatibility, probes whether each can match the goal, and either pushes a candidate or marks ambiguity. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::push_candidate` and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous`.

Selects the underlying trait obligation to derive impl-based projection candidates, then records ambiguity, selection error, or a usable builtin/user-defined candidate while accounting for specialization and builtin trait cases. Turns a chosen projection candidate into concrete projected progress by delegating to the appropriate confirmation routine and then opportunistically resolving inferred regions in the resulting term. Confirms an impl-selected candidate by dispatching to the appropriate builtin or user-defined confirmation path based on the selected impl source and trait kind. Computes the projected `Coroutine` associated type (`Yield` or `Return`) from the normalized coroutine signature and confirms it as if it came from an environment projection. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Computes the `Future::Output` projection from the normalized coroutine signature of an async future and confirms it through the param-env projection path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Computes the `Iterator::Item` projection from the normalized coroutine signature of a generator and confirms it through the param-env projection path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Computes the `AsyncIterator::Item` projection by normalizing the coroutine signature, extracting the yielded `Poll<Option<Item>>` structure, and confirming the resulting item type through the param-env path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Resolves built-in associated type projections such as discriminant, async destructor, or pointee metadata, building any extra obligations needed, then confirms the resulting projection through the param-env path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.
Normalizes a function pointer signature and confirms its callable output projection via the shared callable path. It calls `confirm_callable_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Builds the effective callable signature for closures or coroutine-closures, including async/coroutine-specific output construction when needed, then confirms the resulting callable projection. It calls `confirm_callable_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.
Constructs the `FnOnce::Output` projection predicate from a callable signature and confirms it through the param-env projection path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate`.

Computes the projected future type for async callable traits by analyzing coroutine-closure, closure, or function-like self types and then confirming the resulting projection predicate. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate`.

Computes the helper projection that derives tupled upvars for a requested async closure kind and confirms it as a param-env style projection. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Confirms a projection candidate taken from the parameter environment by instantiating the cached binder, normalizing the obligation projection and optionally the candidate projection with `normalize_with_depth_to`, equating the two projections via inference, and on success extending obligations and calling `assoc_ty_own_obligations`; on failure it returns an error term.

Normalizes a value under the old trait solver and returns any generated obligations. Entry point that normalizes a value while tracking recursion depth and collecting obligations into a fresh buffer. It creates the obligation list with `new` and delegates the actual work to `normalize_with_depth_to`.
Runs normalization into an existing obligation buffer. It constructs an `AssocTypeNormalizer` with `new` and then normalizes by calling `AssocTypeNormalizer::fold` inside `ensure_sufficient_stack`.

Fast pre-check for whether a value may contain aliases that require normalization. It queries the typing mode with `typing_mode`, removes opaque-type flags with `remove` when opaques are rigid, and finally tests the remaining flags with `has_type_flags`.

Constructs an `AssocTypeNormalizer` for old-solver normalization, initializing its context, recursion depth, obligation sink, and universe stack. It debug-checks that `next_trait_solver` is not active.

Top-level fold helper that first resolves inference variables with `resolve_vars_if_possible`, rejects escaping bound variables, checks `needs_normalization`, and if needed recursively normalizes by calling `fold_with`.
Returns the type context for this folder by calling `tcx` on the selection context.
Normalizes inside a binder while tracking universe state. It pushes a new universe marker with `push`, recursively folds the binder contents with `super_fold_with`, and restores the stack with `pop`.

Core type-normalization routine for aliases. It first checks `needs_normalization`; non-alias types are recursively handled with `super_fold_with`. Normalizes a predicate only when the predicate `allow_normalization` and `needs_normalization` both hold; in that case it recursively normalizes by calling `super_fold_with`, otherwise it leaves the predicate unchanged.

Dispatches confirmation based on the selected `SelectionCandidate`, builds the corresponding `ImplSource`, and then fixes returned nested obligation depths before producing the final `Selection`. Confirms a projection-derived candidate by recovering the indexed item-bound trait clause from the self type, instantiating and normalizing it, equating it with the obligation trait ref, and adding any extra predicates from projection aliases. Replays where-clause matching for a parameter candidate and returns the resulting nested obligations, treating any mismatch after prior evaluation as an internal bug. It explicitly calls `match_where_clause_trait_ref`.

Confirms builtin trait candidates by computing the builtin-specific conditions and converting any required component types into nested obligations; candidates without nested requirements return no obligations. Confirms a transmutability candidate by evaluating the transmute relation, translating the resulting condition tree into nested trait, lifetime, and freeze obligations, and returning those obligations or an error. Flattens a transmutability condition tree into a linear list of nested obligations, recursively combining conjunction/disjunction branches and delegating reference cases to `reference_obligations`. It explicitly calls itself recursively and `reference_obligations`.
Confirms an auto-trait candidate by resolving the self type, extracting its constituent types, and deriving the auto-trait vtable obligations from them. It explicitly calls `vtable_auto_impl`.

Confirms a user-defined impl candidate by rematching the impl to obtain concrete args and then building the impl source data from that match. It explicitly calls `rematch_impl` and `vtable_impl`.

Builds `ImplSourceUserDefinedData` for a concrete impl by collecting the impl or trait predicates induced by the chosen args and then extending them with normalization obligations carried in the matched args. It explicitly calls `impl_or_trait_obligations`.

Confirms a trait-object candidate by selecting the indexed supertrait from the object's principal trait, normalizing and equating it with the obligation, then adding obligations for explicit supertraits and associated-type bounds needed by the object. It explicitly calls `normalize_with_depth_to`.

Confirms a function-pointer candidate by building the corresponding closure-trait reference from the function signature, equating it with the obligation, and adding the `Output: Sized` obligation required by `FnOnce`. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs` and `normalize_with_depth_to`.
Confirms a trait-alias candidate by expanding the alias into the obligations implied by the aliased trait definition. It explicitly calls `impl_or_trait_obligations`.

Confirms a coroutine candidate by deriving the coroutine trait reference and outputs from the coroutine signature and equating that trait reference with the obligation. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs`.
Confirms a future candidate by deriving the `Future` trait reference from the coroutine signature and equating it with the obligation. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs`.
Confirms an iterator candidate by deriving the iterator trait reference from the coroutine signature and equating it with the obligation. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs`.
Confirms an async-iterator candidate by deriving the async-iterator trait reference from the coroutine signature and equating it with the obligation. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs`.

Confirms a closure candidate by constructing the expected closure trait reference for either a normal closure or coroutine closure and then unifying it with the obligation. It explicitly calls `equate_trait_refs`.

Confirms an async-closure-style candidate by deriving the appropriate trait reference for coroutine closures, fn items/pointers, or closures, adding any required `Future` obligations for returned values, and then unifying the derived trait reference with the obligation. Instantiates the found poly trait ref, normalizes it together with the obligation trait ref, and equates the two while returning any resulting nested obligations or a signature-mismatch error. It explicitly calls `normalize_with_depth`.

Confirms a trait-upcasting unsize candidate by extracting the source and target dyn principals, selecting the indexed supertrait principal from the source, and matching that upcast against the target object to produce builtin trait-upcasting obligations. Confirms builtin unsizing by analyzing the resolved source and target types and producing the appropriate `ImplSource` plus nested obligations for dyn upcasts, pointer/array unsizing, and related builtin coercions. It does not explicitly call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Confirms a `~const Destruct` candidate by first short-circuiting in the current non-const path, otherwise checking any explicit const-drop impl and then deriving recursive obligations from the structure of the self type. When an `impl_def_id` is present, it explicitly calls `rematch_impl` to recover impl arguments and `vtable_impl` under `ensure_sufficient_stack` to validate the impl and collect its nested obligations; afterward it inspects the resolved self type, expands ADT fields into a work stack, and walks constituent types to accumulate additional destruct-related obligations.

Examines one autoderef stage to determine how the callee can be invoked. It recognizes direct builtin callable types, records deferred resolution for closures or coroutine-closures whose callable kind is still unknown, and otherwise attempts trait-based dispatch by calling `try_overloaded_call_traits`; on success it prepares adjustments and returns the corresponding `CallStep`.

Searches the `Fn*` and `AsyncFn*` trait families for a callable method applicable to the adjusted callee type, preferring trait order based on whether the callee is a coroutine closure. It computes the tupled argument input type, performs trait-method lookup, registers resulting obligations, and returns any needed autoref adjustment plus the selected `MethodCallee`. This method does not call other listed file methods.

Detects the parser pattern where a block-bodied closure definition is immediately followed by call syntax without parentheses and emits a multipart suggestion to wrap the closure. It also handles the async-closure desugaring case when locating the real closure declaration span. This method does not call other listed file methods.

Recognizes a likely mistaken array element separator, where tuple-like syntax is being called inside an array literal, and suggests inserting a comma after the tuple expression. Returns whether the suggestion was emitted. This method does not call other listed file methods.

Finalizes checking of a direct builtin call on a function item or function pointer. It calls `enforce_context_effects` for `FnDef` callees, computes and normalizes the function signature, checks argument types against expected inputs, performs diagnostics for non-callable callees, and in the error path may call `suggest_call_as_method` and `report_invalid_callee`.

Builds a diagnostic suggestion that rewrites a failed free-function-style call into method-call syntax when method probing succeeds on the first argument. This method does not call other listed file methods.

Creates the main error for attempting to call a non-callable expression, with specialized suggestions for unit constructors, misplaced closure syntax, local function items, bad array syntax, multiline formatting, and unsized callees. It calls `identify_bad_closure_def_and_call` and `maybe_suggest_bad_array_definition` while refining diagnostics.

Checks arguments for a closure call whose exact callable trait kind has been deferred, using the known closure signature to derive expected input types and return type. It calls `check_argument_types` and returns the closure signature output.

Enforces that a called function's host-effect const parameter matches the effect expected for the current body. It equates the body effect with the callee's host-effect argument, registering obligations on success or emitting a mismatched-const diagnostic otherwise. This method does not call other listed file methods.

Finalizes an overloaded call resolved through a callable trait method. It calls `check_method_argument_types` to type-check the call against the selected `MethodCallee`, then calls `write_method_call_and_enforce_effects` to record the method call and enforce any context effects, returning the method output type.

Completes a previously deferred closure-call resolution once closure kind inference has finished. It calls `try_overloaded_call_traits` to pick the appropriate callable trait method, equates the old deferred signature with the resolved method signature, applies stored plus autoref adjustments, and calls `write_method_call_and_enforce_effects` to record the resolved method call.

Temporarily composes the ambient variance with the requested variance, short-circuits if the result is bivariant, and otherwise relates the values under the adjusted variance. It explicitly calls `relate` on the non-bivariant path.

Core type relation routine: fast-paths equal types, shallow-resolves inference variables, emits deferred subtype goals for unresolved var-vs-var subtype cases, equates or instantiates type variables when possible, reports errors for erroneous types, structurally combines ordinary types, and delegates opaque-type handling to the inference context when needed. Relates regions by translating the current ambient variance into region constraints: covariant and contravariant cases create subregion constraints, while invariant creates an equality constraint; it does not call any other listed methods.
Relates consts by delegating to `InferCtxt::super_combine_consts`; it does not call any other listed methods.

Relates higher-ranked binders by first trying the no-bound-vars fast path and otherwise using universe-based instantiation: covariance enters `forall` on the right and instantiates the left with fresh vars, contravariance does the dual, and equality uses placeholder/fresh-variable instantiations to enforce a one-to-one correspondence. It explicitly calls `relate` in the no-bound-vars fast path and during higher-ranked instantiated comparisons.
Returns the diagnostic span from the current trace; it does not call any other listed methods.
Returns the current parameter environment; it does not call any other listed methods.
Returns whether aliases should be structurally related; it does not call any other listed methods.
Forwards predicate registration to the underlying combine fields; it does not call any other listed methods.
Registers deferred goals by forwarding them to the combine fields' obligation registration; it does not call any other listed methods.

Builds and registers an `AliasRelate` predicate whose direction depends on the ambient variance: subtype for covariant/contravariant cases and equate for invariant. It explicitly calls `register_predicates` to enqueue the constructed predicate.

Computes well-formedness obligations for an already-resolved generic argument without normalization, returning `None` for unresolved non-region inference variables and an empty list for lifetimes. It calls `WfPredicates::compute` and returns the raw accumulated obligations.

Builds the well-formedness obligations induced by a trait predicate in an item context, enabling full elaboration of implied supertrait-style requirements. It calls `WfPredicates::compute_trait_pred` with `Elaborate::All`, then calls `WfPredicates::normalize` on the collected obligations.

Dispatches well-formedness obligation generation based on the kind of a `ty::Clause`. Improves diagnostics for associated-item-related obligations by retargeting an obligation cause span to the original impl associated item when a projection- or trait-based predicate can be traced back to that item. It inspects impl items and predicate structure but does not call other methods from this file.
Returns the `TyCtxt` stored in the inference context. It does not call other methods from this file.
Constructs an `ObligationCause` using the current span and body id. It does not call other methods from this file.

Normalizes the collected WF obligations unless the new trait solver is enabled, in which case it returns them unchanged. It calls `WfPredicates::cause` once to build the shared normalization cause, then normalizes each predicate while preserving accumulated side obligations.

Computes WF obligations for a trait predicate, handling negative predicates by only checking argument WF and positive predicates by adding the trait's nominal predicates, optionally elaborating implied supertrait obligations, and generating WF obligations for each non-lifetime argument. It calls `WfPredicates::tcx`, `WfPredicates::compute_negative_trait_pred` for negative predicates, `WfPredicates::nominal_obligations` for the trait's declared predicates, and `extend_cause_with_original_assoc_item_obligation` to improve diagnostic spans.
Computes WF requirements for a negative trait predicate by requiring each trait argument to be well formed. It calls `WfPredicates::compute` for every argument in the trait reference.

Computes WF obligations for an inherent associated type projection by first deriving instantiated impl arguments when the self type has no escaping bound vars, adding the inherent item's nominal predicates, and then checking the original projection arguments for WF. It calls `WfPredicates::cause`, `WfPredicates::nominal_obligations`, and `WfPredicates::compute_projection_args`.

Adds direct `WellFormed(arg)` obligations for each type or const projection argument that has no escaping bound variables. It calls `WfPredicates::tcx` and `WfPredicates::cause` to build those obligations.
Adds a `Sized` trait obligation for a type when the type has no escaping bound variables. It calls `WfPredicates::cause` and `WfPredicates::tcx` to construct the obligation.

Recursively walks a generic argument and generates the core WF obligations for contained types and consts, handling many type forms specially: unevaluated consts gain nominal and const-evaluatable obligations, inference consts gain explicit WF obligations, structural/container types recurse through their contents, DST-sensitive forms require `Sized` where appropriate, projections delegate to projection-specific handling, and trait objects produce region-bound obligations. It calls `WfPredicates::nominal_obligations`, `WfPredicates::cause`, `WfPredicates::tcx`, `WfPredicates::require_sized`, `WfPredicates::compute_projection`, `WfPredicates::compute_inherent_projection`, and `WfPredicates::from_object_ty`.

Builds instantiated predicate obligations from the declared predicates of a nominal item and all of its predicate-bearing parents, tagging each with an appropriate item/binding cause and filtering out obligations with escaping bound vars. It calls `WfPredicates::tcx` and `WfPredicates::cause` while constructing the obligations.

Generates outlives obligations implied by a trait object's existential predicates and explicit object lifetime bound, requiring the explicit bound to outlive each implicit bound extracted from the object. It calls `object_region_bounds`, `WfPredicates::tcx`, and `WfPredicates::cause`.

Traverses a type and emits the well-formedness obligations required by its kind. Checks a constant for well-formedness based on its const kind. For unevaluated consts without escaping bound vars, it collects nominal obligations with `nominal_obligations`, appends them with `extend`, and pushes a `ConstEvaluatable` obligation using `cause`, `tcx`, and `with_depth`; for inference consts it pushes a `WellFormed` obligation the same way; otherwise it falls back to recursive traversal with `super_visit_with` for remaining const structure.
Rejects direct predicate well-formedness checking by immediately triggering an internal `bug!` failure; it does not delegate to any other methods in this file.

Computes the region bounds required by a trait object's existential predicates by substituting a fresh placeholder self type, ignoring projection predicates, and delegating the final extraction to `required_region_bounds`. It calls `required_region_bounds`.

Elaborates a set of clauses and extracts the concrete regions from `TypeOutlives(erased_self_ty, region)` predicates whose region does not contain escaping bound variables, ignoring all other clause kinds. It does not call other methods from this file.

Computes well-formedness obligations for an alias/projection term by first calling `nominal_obligations` to collect the associated item and enclosing trait predicates, extending `self.out` with those obligations via `extend`, and then calling `compute_projection_args` to require the alias arguments themselves to be well formed. The recorded self-call reflects recursive handling in the call graph for nested alias terms.
